attribution.note: Marcus explicitly endorses the negative forecast through his bet; Musk's quoted prediction is distinct.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves Marcus's stated capability test and end-of-2025 deadline. His bet commits him to a definite outcome.

contract.note: Human-solvable tasks fit Marcus's test, but the contract substitutes near-deadline verified performance for all systems' capabilities at the deadline. Marcus did not supply that temporal or coverage substitution.

evidence.note: The benchmark organizer reports substantial verified AI shortfalls on December 5. This supports the forecast's direction but does not establish capabilities through December 31 or cover unverified systems.
The task-validation report establishes human solvability of the evaluation tasks. Combined with December scores, it supports a measured capability gap, but does not establish the year-end outcome.

output.rationale: The packet establishes human-solvable tasks that verified AI systems had not mastered on December 5, 2025. It does not settle whether a qualifying system arrived during the remaining 26 days. Treating that snapshot as the deadline outcome requires the contract's unsupported substitution. No material counterevidence was supplied.
